translations.text: For this reason I endure these things, and I am not ashamed. For I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him for me until that day.
Let the sound words you heard from me be your pattern, in the faith and love that are in Jesus Christ.
But when he came to Rome, he searched diligently for me and found me.
If we endure, we will also reign with him. But if we deny him, he will also deny us.
Therefore, if anyone cleanses himself from these things, he becomes a clean vessel for honorable use, suitable for his master's use and prepared for every good work.
Traitors, reckless, arrogant, loving pleasures more than they love God,
And all who want to live in the fear of God in Jesus Christ will be persecuted.
Every scripture written by the Spirit is useful for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
But you, be alert in everything, endure hardships, do the work of a preacher of the good news, and fulfill your ministry.
And my Lord will rescue me from every evil deed and save me in his heavenly kingdom. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Erastus stayed in Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick in the city of Miletus.
